transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Mobile technical queries, my name is Simon.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Hello Simon, my name is Nathan Cross. I cannot receive any incoming text messages or two-factor authentication SMS codes on my Samsung phone: voice calls and 4G data work fine, but text messages have completely stopped delivering for three days!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Good afternoon Nathan. If I understand correctly, your mobile phone has stopped delivering all incoming SMS text messages and bank verification passcodes while your voice and data connections remain functional. Before we run diagnostic checks, could you confirm your full postal address and your account security PIN?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Yes, it is 79 Queensway, Southampton, SO14 3BL, security PIN 9914, mobile number 07700 900612.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you Nathan, that confirms your account details. Have you checked whether your Samsung Messages app spam filter is intercepting shortcode numbers?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I checked the spam folder, cleared the app cache, and even tried a third-party messaging app; no SMS messages are arriving at all!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Could I place you on hold for two minutes while I query the mobile SMS router routing gateway?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for holding, Nathan. The core mobile gateway indicates that your SIM card's SMS Center number was cleared during a recent Android system update.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Why would an Android system update wipe out my SMS Center number?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Operating system patches occasionally overwrite carrier APN and SMSC parameters stored on the SIM card.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you push the correct SMSC number over the air to my phone?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: If you keep entering the wrong verification codes into your banking app, the bank blocks your account; that isn't our network's fault.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I didn't enter the wrong codes! The codes never arrived because your network isn't delivering SMS! Why are you blaming me?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I am explaining how automated fraud prevention mechanisms lock customer profiles.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I don't care about the bank's fraud software right now! I need the SMS Center number updated on my SIM card!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The national S-Net SMSC address is plus forty-four seven seven eight five zero one six zero zero zero.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Where do I input that number on a Samsung Galaxy S23?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Open Samsung Messages, tap the three dots menu, select Settings, tap More Settings, and tap Text Messages.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Found it: 'Message Centre'. It is currently set to blank!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Obviously mobile handsets route text messages through the international Short Message Service Center address stored on the SIM card.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Typing in +447785016000 now... Tapped Set. It is saved.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Nathan speaking, I have missed three urgent SMS security passcodes from my bank, and my online banking account is now locked! I have mortgage settlement funds due today and I cannot authorize the wire transfer because S-Net cannot deliver a simple text message! I am about to lose the purchase of my home and I am beyond furious!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I completely understand the intense panic and fury this is causing with your mortgage settlement at stake today, Nathan. Missing bank verification passcodes when buying a home is an emergency, and I will diagnose your mobile text delivery profile immediately.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Can you send a test SMS from your network switchboard to see if messages deliver now?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have dispatched an automated gateway test message to your mobile number.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I am watching my phone screen... Nothing is coming through.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: SMSC routing updates require an over-the-air network re-registration cycle.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: How long does that network re-registration take?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Home Location Register propagates SMS routing updates within two to twenty-four hours.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Two to twenty-four hours?! My mortgage wire transfer deadline is at four o'clock this afternoon!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Core mobile network routing propagation cannot be accelerated for individual subscriber records.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So I cannot receive my bank passcodes before four o'clock today?!

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You would have to contact your bank and request telephone voice verification instead of SMS passcodes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: My bank only offers SMS two-factor authentication for wire transfers over ten thousand pounds.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Telecommunications carriers do not control banking security protocols.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: This delay is putting my entire home purchase at extreme risk.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have verified that the SMSC configuration is now correct on both your SIM and our HLR.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: So the fix is applied, but the network propagation prevents it working right now.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Correct. The messages will deliver once carrier propagation completes.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I see. I will have to telephone my solicitor and beg for an extension on the mortgage settlement.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have documented your SMSC update under mobile case reference SMS-88192-N.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: SMS-88192-N, noted down.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Before I update the mobile profile, what was your mobile number again?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Like I said earlier, it is 07700 900612.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have attached the mobile number to the formal network propagation ticket.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I hope the text messages start arriving before the close of business.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You can restart your handset every hour to prompt the phone to poll the network for pending SMS queues.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: I will reboot the phone at the top of every hour.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I have also waived this month's mobile line rental charge as a goodwill gesture for the disruption.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Thank you for the credit, but the priority was getting those bank passcodes.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Is there any other mobile issue I can assist you with today, Nathan?

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: No Simon, that is all.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Goodbye.

transcript.speaker: Customer
transcript.text: Goodbye.
